title: Rav Menasheh bar Shegovli
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Eruvin 29, the reading has bar Dari reporting in the name of Rav Menashya bar Shegovli, in the name of Rav. Rav Yosef said, “May his Master forgive him.”[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The heading has Menasheh (מנשה), while the body has Menashya (מנשיא). Both forms are retained.

Hyman writes גורסין, “the reading has,” followed by bar Dari reporting in the name of Rav Menashya bar Shegovli in the name of Rav. The referent of bar Dari and the precise reading being reported remain unclear; the three-stage transmission chain is preserved.
Eruvin 29 is cited without a definite folio side. שרי ליה מריה is the wish “May his Master forgive him,” not a report that forgiveness occurred.
